messages:
noah: Heads-up: running tenant_meta ADD COLUMN + backfill tonight. Proposing quiet-slot 00:45 UTC, 20m cap. Resharding might hit 01:00 so earlier seems safer.

riley: 00:45 + 20m cap works. If reshard touches same ranges we abort early.

sana: Rollback triggers: sustained p99 write > 320ms for 5m OR error rate > 2% for two waves OR queue backlog increases by >8k rows => stop. Also abort if backfill throughput < 350 rows/s after 5m.

noah: I'll pin services to v2.15.0 for the window and gate with feature flag. deploy-bot, schedule please.

deploy-bot: Migration scheduled: tenant_meta_add_status_col (id: 3265432100). Start: 2026-04-02T00:45:00Z. Plan: canary on 1 tenant, then waves of 3. Operators: @noah @riley @sana.

riley: Ops play: if abort -> set `flags.tenant_meta_backfill=false`, then `systemctl stop backfill-workers` and allow in-flight writes to finish. DB relief: `SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ILIKE '%tenant_meta%' AND state='active';`

sana: SQL is online-safe: `ALTER TABLE tenant_meta ADD COLUMN status text;` then `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_tenant_status ON tenant_meta(status);` Backfill is idempotent row updates from workers. No exclusive locks expected.

deploy-bot: Canary started on tenant t-9 at 2026-04-02T00:45:14Z. Canary result: ok.

riley: Launching wave 1/3. Watching p99, queue length, worker error rate.

deploy-bot: Wave 3/3 complete. Migration 3265432100 finished for 9/9 tenants at 2026-04-02T00:48:05Z. No aborts triggered.

noah: Great. Monitoring for 25m then close the window. If anything degrades, open a rollback thread and follow runbook.
